CustomField.description: Sum of Grant Period Amount across every Gift Transaction under this grant's Gift Commitment whose Grant Period Status is Received. Maintained by the Roll Up Government Grant Award Paid flow - it cannot be a native roll-up summary because Gift Transactions are children of the Gift Commitment, not of the Opportunity. Do not edit by hand; the next transaction save overwrites it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Reimbursements received to date, totalled from the Gift Transactions under this grant's Gift Commitment. Calculated - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Total Award Paid
